version: v1.1 (Tomás, round 4, 2026-10-01): bottle row now Hudson Do The Rye Thing, 46% (Hester T2), numbers unchanged. Story: Erenzo and the Tuthilltown amateurs (Wren r1, re-centred). A Manhattan on the rocks with a split base: Hudson New York rye (Oxford HUDSON pdf 1037, 92 proof, 100% New York rye) with American apple brandy, for the amateurs' first product, a vodka from New York apples (same page). Split base after Codex p. 22 (apple brandy pulled in to accent rye). Stirred, strained over one large cube; judged on the stirred bands, rock melt checked by hand (+20 ml holds). Rye swept 40-50%, apple brandy 40-50%: all in range. Demerara 2.5 ml lifts sugar off the stirred floor (3.69 without it, which on the rock would fall OUT).
